doc: Chapter 3, Mars Pathfinder (July 1997) (issue #47; story: docs/design/story-v0.3.0.md). Every fact from NASA pages (S-mpf-nasa, S-mpf-nssdc, S-mpf-jpl). Inti, inside the airbags, counts the bounces (the story's line). Same format as apollo13.json.
mission: Between intro and outro the player plays the mission: the descent (steady, rockets, cut), the bounces, Sojourner down the ramp (scripts/screens/pathfinder.gd).

intro.text: Four years after Hubble, the cuyes went farther than ever: seven months to Mars, inside a lander wrapped in airbags.
intro.fact: Mars Pathfinder launched on December 4, 1996, and landed on Mars on July 4, 1997.

intro.text: No rockets all the way down this time. A parachute, three little rockets, then airbags. You land by bouncing.
intro.fact: Rockets fired at 98 m; the bridle was cut 21.5 m above the ground, releasing the airbag-encased lander.

intro.text: A flood plain! Old water made all these rocks. I want to see every one.
Then we bounce over every one.
Calm at the stick, they said. Nobody said anything about airbags.
Steady the lander, fire the rockets, cut the bridle. Then hold on.
intro.fact: The parachute slowed the craft to about 70 m/s; the radar found the ground at about 1.6 km.

outro.text: Fourteen... fifteen... sixteen... I stopped counting. The ground keeps moving.
outro.fact: The lander bounced about 12 meters up, then at least another 15 times, and came to rest about 2.5 minutes later, 1 km away.

outro.text: Six wheels on Mars! The first wheels on another planet!
outro.fact: Sojourner was the first wheeled vehicle to be used on any other planet in the solar system.

outro.text: Planned for seven days. It drove for eighty-three. Classic.
outro.fact: Sojourner spent 83 days of a planned seven-day mission exploring the Martian terrain.

outro.text: Next mission is strange. Killa, they want you to crash into the Moon. On purpose.

outro.title: To be continued
outro.sub: Next: the plan is to crash?, 2009
